page_title: LAZ 2-1 PIS | Lazio v Pisa 23/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+2' A precise low pass is received by Adrian Przyborek (Lazio), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the left post.
90+1' A corner kick by Lazio is thwarted by the well prepared Adrian Semper (Pisa).
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
90' Felipe Loyola (Pisa) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
82' The substitution has been made. Adrian Przyborek has replaced Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio).
82' Maurizio Sarri decides to make a substitution. Luca Pellegrini will be replaced by Manuel Lazzari (Lazio).
81' Rosen Bozhinov (Pisa) spurns a big chance! He makes himself some space to meet a cross and from near the penalty spot sends a header well wide of the left post!
77' That will be all from Arturo Calabresi (Pisa) who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Brando Bettazzi.
76' Looks like Alessio Furlanetto (Lazio) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
72' Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
71' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) goes off the pitch and Daniel Maldini comes on.
71' The referee signals a substitution. Juan Cuadrado is brought on as a substitute for Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa).
69' Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
67' Adam Marusic (Lazio) receives an accurate pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, his effort goes high above the crossbar.
63' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
62' Substitution. Gabriele Piccinini replaces Filip Stojilkovic (Pisa).
61' Here is a change. Michel Aebischer is going off and Oscar Hiljemark gives the last tactical orders to Felipe Loyola (Pisa).
61' Maurizio Sarri has decided to substitute Pedro and he is replaced by Boulaye Dia (Lazio).
60' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) plants a header from the edge of the box after a nice cross from the free kick. It lacks accuracy and the ball flies way over the bar.
60' The referee signals a free kick from long distance for Pisa.
59' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) brings an opponent down and Maria Caputi interrupts the game.
55' Reda Belahyane (Lazio) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar.
55' Pedro (Lazio) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

54' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lazio.
52' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) heads on.
50' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) takes a great touch after receiving a pass inside the box. He immediately unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off a decent save!
48' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Adrian Semper makes a comfortable save.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Oscar Hiljemark gives a chance to Malthe Hojholt and Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Pisa) is off.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Mario Gila (Lazio) is replaced by Oliver Provstgaard.
45+1' The match has reached half-time.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Toma Basic (Lazio) receives an accurate pass and finds some space for a shot. The keeper is prepared and denies his long-range attempt straight to the middle of the goal.

37' This was a piece of cake for Adrian Semper. Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went towards the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
35' 2 - 1 Goal! Tijjani Noslin pulls the ball back for Pedro (Lazio) on the edge of the box, and he beats the keeper with a fine strike inside the left post. 2:1.
35' Toma Basic (Lazio) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

33' 1 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Reda Belahyane, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio), who beats Adrian Semper with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
29' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
28' Samuele Angori (Pisa) takes the corner with a short pass.

27' It's unbelievable, Samuele Angori (Pisa) blows a huge opportunity! He is totally unmarked and fires a first-time shot towards goal from a few yards out, but Alessio Furlanetto reacts superbly to keep the ball out. The ball is out of play and Pisa manage to earn a corner.
23' 0 - 1 Goal! Michel Aebischer plays a hopeful cross into a crowded box. Stefano Moreo (Pisa) times his jump perfectly and sends a header inside the left post from close in. 0:1.
18' Michel Aebischer (Pisa) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
16' Lazio seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
12' Toma Basic (Lazio) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Adrian Semper has no trouble gathering it.

11' A sweet pass finds Pedro (Lazio) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the right side of the goal. Adrian Semper is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. Lazio win a corner.
10' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Mario Gila (Lazio) was quite harsh and Maria Caputi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
9' Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Pisa) commits a foul and Maria Caputi immediately signals a free kick.
8' Adam Marusic (Lazio) latches onto a pass inside the box, steps inside his marker and smacks a shot against the right post.
7' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lazio.

6' What an amazing save by Adrian Semper! Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot towards the middle of the target, but fails. The referee points to the corner flag and Lazio will take a corner.
4' Reda Belahyane (Lazio) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
4' Half-chance! Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) plays a pass into the box, but Adrian Semper reacts well to snuff out the attack.
3' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
1' Isak Vural (Pisa) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post.
1' 1 - 1 The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Pisa will have the kick-off.
Maria Caputi will supervise the game today.
